description: Implementation of a pseudo-random generator with functions for initialization, state advancement, bit and float generation, and XOR operations, utilizing SIMD instructions for performance.

classes.name: pseudo_random_generator_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for pseudo-random number generation, supporting initialization, state management, bit/float generation, and XOR operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the generator state with a seed or a given state.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the generator state by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random bits into a bit buffer.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random floats with a specified value, using SIMD for parallel processing.

methods.name: apply_xor
methods.description: Applies XOR operation between input and output buffers, modifying the output buffer.

methods.name: apply_xor
methods.description: Applies XOR operation between input and output spans of bytes.

methods.name: get_state
